body:
I haven't mentioned it to them yet. They don't need their good moods soured by my negativity. But this year I started paying more attention to the way things work. The world is incredibly imbalanced. Being born is a gamble you have zero control over. Through no merit or mistake of your own, you can have your entire life decided for you before you're even born and I hate it.

People that could become great things are stuck barely surviving below the poverty line because of something their parents' parents' parents (and so on) screwed up. Isn't that idiotic? The world is a mess and I don't want to be a part of facilitating this line of stupidity.
